/api/v5/approval-tasks/{id}/approve.summary:
Approve a pending approval task and execute the original command.
Requires the current user to hold approval permission for the task's module and risk level.

/api/v5/approval-tasks/{id}/reject.summary:
Reject a pending approval task.
Requires the current user to hold approval permission for the task's module and risk level.

/api/v5/approval-tasks/{id}/recall.summary:
Recall (cancel) a pending approval task.
Only the original submitter can recall their own task.

/api/v5/approval-tasks/{id}/chase.summary:
Chase (re-notify) the approver of a pending approval task.
Only the original submitter can chase their own task.
Re-publishes a PendingNotificationEvent to remind the approver.
